dsh-vision-subagent is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Vision for any DSH route: paste images in the Web composer with intent-aware auto-analysis, delegate workspace image reads to a Kimi/MiniMax vision subagent, and materialize pasted originals for editing.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-8c2864a50158a88324e0.html
